description: Defines IPC message-related classes and types within the Thunder::Core::IPC namespace, including ScalarType templates, Text, BufferType, and related utilities.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Template class for scalar data types, specialized for string type.

classes.name: ScalarType<string>
classes.description: Specialization of ScalarType for std::string, with serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Template class for fixed-length text handling with serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: BufferType
classes.description: Template class for buffer management, wrapping Core::FrameType.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Gets or sets the scalar value in ScalarType.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns length of Text or ScalarType string.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte buffer into the object.
